name: New Holstice
description: New Holstice was a Mid Rim hospital world between Belderone and Roche. It was part of the Galactic Republic since before 4000 BBY, and contained a monument to all Jedi killed since the formation of the Republic.
lead_paragraphs: New Holstice was a Mid Rim hospital world between Belderone and Roche. It was part of the Galactic Republic since before 4000 BBY, and contained a monument to all Jedi killed since the formation of the Republic.
The Mandalorian Protectors unsuccessfully attacked the world in 22 BBY.
The planet was the memory moth homeworld.
